root_cause.text: The root cause is the failure to acquire the `route_list_lock` mutex during list entry deletion in `mlxsw_sp_mr_route_add`, permitting a race condition with the `mlxsw_sp_mr_stats_update` worker that results in use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `mutex_lock(&mr_table->route_list_lock)` and `mutex_unlock(&mr_table->route_list_lock)` surrounding `list_del(&mr_orig_route->node)` in `mlxsw_sp_mr_route_add`, directly addressing the CVE description stating that "One instance of list entry deletion (during route replace) was missed" while the driver periodically traverses the list.
